basis: Sepsis is infection with dysregulated host response; the specific organs damaged vary, without a consistently qualifying additional axis.
Malignant bone tumor arising from notochord remnants at the skull base; intracranial proximity alone does not establish neurologic involvement.
Central demyelination defines the disease; bladder and bowel manifestations reflect autonomic neurologic dysfunction rather than intrinsic urinary or intestinal damage.
KCNQ2-related neonatal epilepsy; no additional organ damage is established.
Degenerative disease of the cornea.
Closed spinal dysraphism defined by a skin-to-spinal-cord stalk and a cutaneous/subcutaneous lipomatous lesion.
Carcinoma originating in thyroid follicular epithelium.
MELAS defines mitochondrial metabolic encephalomyopathy; hearing loss occurs in >50% overall. Cardiac involvement omitted at cap; MTND6-specific frequencies are limited.
Toxin-induced damage to peripheral nerves; other toxin effects are not intrinsic to the polyneuropathy concept.
Destructive resorption of dental hard tissues; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Ischemic cerebrovascular disease causing brain necrosis in the anterior cerebral artery territory.
Defined here as a nerve-sheath neoplasm; its characteristic site is dermis or subcutis.
Carcinoma originating in the pituitary gland; no consistent additional organ involvement is established.
Dental dentin/pulp concept, although the supplied definition describes normal secondary dentin formation.
Intellectual disability with developmental delay and structural brain abnormalities; muscle weakness and strabismus are below 30%.
Inherited coagulation defect. Supplied CNS/GI bleeding frequencies conflict with the usual course; severe organ bleeds and hemarthroses affect a minority overall.
Structural disease defined by gastric diverticula.
Disease confined to the epididymis, a reproductive organ outside the thirteen axes.
GI, vertebral/limb and cardiac malformations define VACTERL; airway involvement from tracheoesophageal fistula in 11/11. Renal defects and optional hydrocephalus omitted at cap.
Lentigines and cardiac disease define it; ptosis 8/9 and pectus/skeletal deformities commonly >50%. Hearing loss occurs in ~20%, below threshold.
Defined by microcephaly, growth restriction and limb abnormalities; intellectual/developmental impairment occurs in 15/29.
Metabolic encephalomyopathy with rhabdomyolysis; cardiac electrical dysfunction includes prolonged QTc in 8/13. Frequent GI dysmotility omitted at cap; transaminases may reflect muscle injury.
Neurodevelopmental disability and cataracts define it; kyphosis in 2/6 (~33%) supports skeletal involvement. Immunodeficiency frequency is unestablished.
IL21-related immunodeficiency with defining infantile intestinal inflammation; recurrent respiratory infections do not establish chronic lung damage.
Epiphyseal dysplasia and camptodactyly define skeletal and joint involvement; no additional organ disease is established.
